abstract: Serial assays of serum progesterone and serum human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) were performed in eight cases of choriocarcinoma before and during treatment of the disease. Serum progesterone was measured by the competitive protein-binding technique and serum HCG was measured by the hemagglutination inhibition method. Serum HCG gives a better index of response of the tumor to treatment when compared to serum progesterone. In cases where the ovaries are still present serum progesterone does not disappear completely when the disease is eradicated and fluctuates cyclically, thus reflecting ovarian activity. However, in most cases with pulmonary secondaries, serum progesterone was elevated in spite of undetectable serum HCG. With widespread metastases serum progesterone rose to pregnancy levels and remained persistently high. Cerebrospinal fluid progesterone in a case of choriocarcinoma with cerebral metastasis was 5 ng. per milliliter, which was very much higher than in normal pregnant subjects. The findings of serum progesterone in comparison to serum HCG during therapy of choriocarcinoma are discussed.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌の8症例について、治療前および治療中に血清プロゲステロンと血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を連続測定した。プロゲステロンは競合蛋白結合法で、hCGは赤血球凝集阻止法で測定した。治療反応の指標としては、血清プロゲステロンと比べて血清hCGの方が優れていた。卵巣が残存する症例では、疾患が根絶された後も血清プロゲステロンは完全には消失せず、卵巣活動を反映して周期的に変動した。しかし、肺転移の多くの症例では、血清hCGが検出不能であるにもかかわらず血清プロゲステロンは高値であった。広範な転移病変では、血清プロゲステロンは妊娠時のレベルまで上昇し、持続的に高値を示した。脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の症例では、脳脊髄液中プロゲステロンが5 ng/mlであり、正常妊娠の被験者よりも著しく高値であった。絨毛癌の治療中における血清プロゲステロンと血清hCGの比較所見について考察する。
